title: The Recitation
logline: A man the war made dangerous and the bush made calm goes deeper still — into the Sahara, half-chasing a desert romance he got from a novel — and is taken in by Arabic-speaking desert people who owe him nothing; over seasons of listening to the Quran recited at every prayer, the outsider who will never convert learns the one thing the bush only began: to set fear down.
blueprint: character origin — grounded, not woo (the desert/Quran companion to the Jakobus arc; sibling to The Silver Thread)
market: literary historical — the quiet, respectful sibling of the series joyride; a Western reader's door into the Quran
